name: Create Contact Method { data }
purpose: Shared contact-method writer used by the phone, address and network address API scripts: inside the open transaction it sets PartyId, Label and Comment on the contact method, removes all existing contact-method purposes (billing, shipping, mailing) and clears the cached indicators, then creates one ContactMethodPurpose per entry of the Purpose array (billing=1, shipping=2, mailing=3) and sets the matching cached indicator to true. Returns the last error object.

open_question: Purposes are replaced, not merged: every existing purpose is deleted before the new ones are created, so editing a contact method without a Purpose array removes all its purposes. An unknown purpose name (not billing, shipping or mailing) gives an empty ContactMethodPurposeTypeId (step 65 Case has no default) and still creates a purpose row. The cached indicators are cleared inside the delete loop (steps 50-52), so they are cleared even when there is nothing to delete. The If [False] at step 78 is a placeholder. The contact method record itself is opened by the caller (karbon_kontroller scripts 194, 206, 207) via the transaction.
